label: Dividend yield
short_definition: Trailing twelve-month dividends per share divided by price.

label: Buyback yield
short_definition: Trailing twelve-month share buybacks relative to market cap.

label: Total shareholder yield
short_definition: Dividend yield plus buyback yield, less share-count dilution.
formula_description: Dividend Yield + Buyback Yield - Dilution (share-count growth, TTM)
perimeter: D2026-11-04.4 buyback perimeter;D2026-11-04.2 Q4 DPS by subtraction

label: Dividend payout ratio
short_definition: Dividends per share relative to diluted EPS.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.2 Q4 DPS by subtraction;FSN-store.4 EPS never derived

label: Dividend growth (YoY)
short_definition: Change in dividends per share versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
formula_description: (Dividends per Share[t] - Dividends per Share[t-1]) / Dividends per Share[t-1], same fiscal_period year over year. Computed in mapper/ttm.py -- a purely additive GROWTH_METRICS entry, same mechanism as the locked revenue/EPS growth metrics.

label: Dividend growth (3Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual growth in dividends per share over three fiscal years.
formula_description: (Dividends per Share[t] / Dividends per Share[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, FY periods. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: Cash returned to shareholders
short_definition: Dividends paid plus share buybacks for the period.
formula_description: Dividends Paid + Share Buybacks -- the total cash actually distributed to shareholders in the period, before relating it to Market Cap (that ratio is total_shareholder_yield's job) or to Free Cash Flow (see share_repurchases_pct_fcf/dividends_pct_fcf, computed in expanded_metrics.py).

label: Buybacks as % of FCF
short_definition: Share buybacks relative to trailing twelve-month free cash flow.
formula_description: Share Buybacks (TTM) / Free Cash Flow (TTM) -- what fraction of real cash generation went to buybacks, distinct from buyback_yield (which relates buybacks to Market Cap, not FCF). Computed in expanded_metrics.py.

label: Dividends as % of FCF
short_definition: Dividends paid relative to trailing twelve-month free cash flow.
formula_description: Dividends Paid (TTM) / Free Cash Flow (TTM) -- a cash-based payout coverage check, distinct from payout_ratio (Dividends per Share / Diluted EPS, an earnings-based payout ratio -- the two can diverge meaningfully whenever CFO and Net Income diverge). Computed in expanded_metrics.py.
